requirements: Implement a reusable comparator benchmark runner for the eight frozen workflows ARPIP, FastML, HomoplasyFinder, PAML, PastML, POUTINE, SNPPar and TreeTime.
Do not execute any of the frozen 150 benchmark scenarios during runner implementation or validation.
Do not execute any third-party comparator during runner implementation or validation.
Do not read benchmark truth during runner implementation or validation.
Keep comparator execution truth-blind: the execution phase may read only comparator-facing scenario inputs and frozen execution metadata.
Do not permit a truth path or truth object to enter comparator command construction, comparator subprocess environments, output parsing or prediction normalization.
Use only the frozen environment/run contracts and frozen adapters; the runner must orchestrate them rather than reimplement their scientific logic.
Require executable, environment, source or build locations to be supplied at runtime; do not hard-code machine-specific /home/rwhite/branchsnv-comparator-* paths in reusable runner code.
Create isolated method-by-scenario working directories and preserve command, exit status, stdout, stderr and native comparator outputs.
Normalize predictions only through the frozen adapters after the corresponding comparator invocation has completed.
Record completion failures explicitly; do not convert execution or parsing failures into zero-accuracy predictions.
Separate execution/normalization from truth scoring. Benchmark truth may become readable only in a later scoring phase after normalized predictions and their identities have been finalized.
Use the frozen metric implementation without changing metric definitions.
Runner validation at this stage must use synthetic temporary fixtures that are not any of the frozen S001-S150 benchmark scenarios.
Fail closed on unknown methods, missing required inputs, unexpected output contracts, pre-existing output roots, or inconsistent frozen artifact identities.
